reasons.text: About 13% of this county's corn follows corn. Here corn and soybean are a small share of the cropland, so rotations aren't compared.
In years with a hot July (corn flowering), corn yields here tend to be about 17 bu/ac lower.
In years with little rain from April to September, corn yields here tend to be about 8 bu/ac lower.

range_driver.text: What moves this county's corn range the most is July heat: from about -42 bu/ac in 2012 to about +6 bu/ac in 2009.
